claims.claim_text: Plug has deployed more than 74,000 fuel cell systems and operates more than 275 fueling stations.
claims.subject: Plug Power Inc.
claims.source_quote: the Company has deployed more than 74,000 fuel cell systems, primarily through material handling applications, and operates more than 275 fueling stations.

claims.claim_text: Walmart accounted for 24.2% ($171.8M) of total consolidated revenues in FY2025, but on December 30, 2025, Plug forfeited all vested Walmart warrants and Walmart received only a contingent limited-use license to GenKey escrowed materials.
claims.subject: Plug Power Inc.
claims.object_value: Walmart=24.2% of FY2025 revenue ($171.8M); Walmart warrant cancelled 12/30/2025
claims.source_quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, Walmart, Inc. ("Walmart"), accounted for 24.2% of our total consolidated revenues... On December 30, 2025, the Company entered into an agreement with Walmart pursuant to which the Company agreed to grant Walmart a contingent, limited-use license to access and use certain escrowed GenKey System-related materials and to forfeit all vested portions of the Walmart warrant and the unvested portions of the Walmart warrant were cancelled.

claims.claim_text: Amazon entered a 2022 Transaction Agreement under which Amazon agreed to purchase hydrogen fuel through August 24, 2029, with warrant vesting tied to up to $2.1B aggregate Amazon payments.
claims.subject: Plug Power Inc.
claims.object_value: Amazon hydrogen fuel supply through 2029; warrant fully vests if $2.1B aggregate Amazon payments
claims.source_quote: Amazon agreed to purchase hydrogen fuel from the Company through August 24, 2029... 15,000,000 of the 2022 Amazon Warrant Shares fully vesting if Amazon-related payments of $2.1 billion are made in the aggregate.

claims.claim_text: Hidrogenii JV with Olin commissioned its 15-ton-per-day liquid hydrogen plant in St. Gabriel, Louisiana in April 2025, alongside existing pre-existing plants in Tennessee and Georgia.
claims.subject: Plug Power / Hidrogenii (Olin JV)
claims.object_value: St. Gabriel LA 15 tpd liquid H2 plant commissioned April 2025
claims.source_quote: The joint venture's 15-ton-per-day hydrogen production plant in St. Gabriel, Louisiana commenced operations in April 2025... Plug began producing liquid hydrogen at its hydrogen production plant in St. Gabriel, Louisiana in April 2025.

claims.claim_text: On January 16, 2025, Plug Power Energy Loan Borrower LLC finalized a $1.66 billion DOE Loan Program Office loan guarantee to finance up to six green hydrogen production facilities; on November 7, 2025, Plug announced suspension of activities related to the DOE loan program and recorded a $13.2M charge.
claims.subject: Plug Power Inc. / DOE LPO
claims.object_value: $1.66B DOE LPO loan guarantee finalized 1/16/2025, suspended 11/7/2025; $13.2M charge
claims.source_quote: On January 16, 2025, Plug Power Energy Loan Borrower LLC... finalized a loan guarantee of up to $1.66 billion with the U.S. Department of Energy (the "DOE") through the DOE's Loan Program Office to finance the development, construction, and ownership of up to six green hydrogen production facilities. On November 7, 2025, the Company announced that it suspended activities related to the DOE loan program.

claims.claim_text: Plug qualified for the IRA Section 45V Clean Hydrogen PTC at its Georgia hydrogen production plant; recognized $7.1M PTC in 2025 ($4.0M in 2024) via elective pay.
claims.subject: Plug Power Inc.
claims.object_value: Georgia plant 45V eligible; $7.1M PTC FY2025; $4.0M FY2024
claims.source_quote: In 2024, the Company determined that it qualifies for the clean hydrogen PTC resulting from operation of the Company's hydrogen production plant located in Georgia... For the year ended December 31, 2025 the Company recognized PTC of $7.1 million...

claims.claim_text: Plug holds 52 issued active US patents (expiring 2026-2044) with 23 US patent applications pending; IP covers fuel-cell components, system designs, manufacturing processes, and control strategies.
claims.subject: Plug Power Inc.
claims.object_value: 52 issued active US patents; 23 pending applications (as of 2025 year-end)
claims.source_quote: We have a total of 52 issued patents currently active with the United States Patent and Trademark Office ("USPTO"), expiring between 2026 and 2044. At the close of 2025, we had 23 U.S. patent applications pending.

claims.claim_text: Plug built a state-of-the-art electrolyzer gigafactory in Rochester, NY and a fuel cell manufacturing facility in Slingerlands, NY; plus 5MW and 10MW PEM electrolyzer offerings to reach into 'the gigawatt-scale electrolyzer market.'
claims.subject: Plug Power Inc.
claims.object_value: Rochester NY electrolyzer gigafactory; Slingerlands NY fuel cell facility; 5MW + 10MW building blocks targeting GW-scale
claims.source_quote: Plug has built a state-of-the-art gigafactory to produce electrolyzer stacks in Rochester, New York... Scaling Plug's electrolyzer program to provide comprehensive and economical solutions focused on our 5-megawatt ("MW") and 10MW offerings and using these building blocks to reach into the gigawatt-scale electrolyzer market.

claims.claim_text: AccionaPlug S.L. (50/50 JV with Acciona in Spain) intends to develop clean hydrogen projects in Spain and Portugal and 'has received initial project financing commitments'; Plug is also 'actively advancing multi-megawatt electrolyzer projects' in Portugal, Europe, Australia.
claims.subject: Plug Power España S.L. / Acciona
claims.object_value: AccionaPlug JV initial project financing commitments; Portugal/Europe/Australia MW projects
claims.source_quote: Our wholly-owned subsidiary, Plug Power España S.L. ("Plug Power Spain"), entered into a joint venture with Acciona, named AccionaPlug S.L., in the fourth quarter of 2021... AccionaPlug S.L. is owned 50% by Plug Power Spain and 50% by Acciona and has received initial project financing commitments.

claims.claim_text: Plug sold its 49% equity interest in SK Plug Hyverse to SK Innovation for $6.5M cash on December 31, 2025; this terminated the marquee Korean/Asian hydrogen JV which generated $0 related-party revenue in 2025 vs $6.4M in 2024 and $2.3M in 2023.
claims.subject: Plug Power Inc. / SK Innovation
claims.object_value: 49% SK Plug Hyverse interest sold for $6.5M on 12/31/2025; related-party revenue $0/2025 vs $6.4M/2024
claims.source_quote: On December 31, 2025, the Company executed a share purchase agreement (the "Share Purchase Agreement") with SK Innovation pursuant to which the Company agreed to sell, and SK Innovation agreed to purchase, the Company's entire 49% equity interest in SK Plug Hyverse. The Company received $6.5 million in cash in connection with the sale.

claims.claim_text: Plug recorded net losses of $1.7B (2025), $2.1B (2024), and $1.4B (2023). Working capital $799.7M (incl. $368.5M unrestricted cash, $186.7M current restricted cash). $944.1M ATM equity capacity remaining (B. Riley + Yorkville); $1.0B SEPA with Yorkville. Authorized shares increased 1.5B → 3.0B in February 2026. Sold 34.6M shares in 2025 at $1.62 weighted average price for $55.9M gross.
claims.subject: Plug Power Inc.
claims.object_value: $1.7B FY2025 net loss; $368.5M unrestricted cash; $944.1M ATM available; share authorization 1.5B→3.0B; FY2025 ATM weighted-avg $1.62/share
claims.source_quote: The Company incurred net losses of approximately $1.7 billion, $2.1 billion and $1.4 billion for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023... unrestricted cash and cash equivalents of $368.5 million... the Company had $944.1 million of aggregate gross sales price of shares available to be sold under the at-the-market equity offering program... an amendment to the Company's amended and restated certificate of incorporation, as amended, to increase the number of authorized shares of the Company's common stock from 1,500,000,000 shares to 3,000,000,000 shares.
